key: Welcome to Critical Capture! Specialty balls to make sure you get that third shake!
en: Welcome to Critical Capture! Specialty balls to make sure you get that third shake!
ja: 「クリティカルキャプチャー」へようこそ! あと一押しをものにする特製ボール、そろえております!

key: Good luck, and have a ball!
en: Good luck, and have a ball!
ja: 頑張ってね、いいボールライフを!

key: I'm disappointed they don't have Dusk and Level Balls. I guess they sold out?
en: I'm disappointed they don't have Dusk and Level Balls. I guess they sold out?
ja: ダークボールとレベルボールが置いてないのは残念だな。売り切れかな?

key: Hum. The craftsmanship on these balls is somewhat cheap.
en: Hum. The craftsmanship on these balls is somewhat cheap.
ja: ふむ。このボールの作り、いくぶん安っぽいな。

key: Sorry to nitpick; I used to be a ball designer myself, so it irks me to see these factory made-in-Kalos balls not being quite up to snuff.
en: Sorry to nitpick; I used to be a ball designer myself, so it irks me to see these factory made-in-Kalos balls not being quite up to snuff.
ja: 細かいこと言ってすまないが、昔ボールのデザイナーをやっていたもんでね、カロス製の量産品がいまいちなのを見ると気になってしまうんだ。

key: Hmm? You say you found a corrupted ball?
en: Hmm? You say you found a corrupted ball?
ja: ん? 壊れたボールを見つけたって?

key: Well, what'd I tell you? It's not surprising.
en: Well, what'd I tell you? It's not surprising.
ja: ほら見ろ、言った通りだろう。驚くことじゃない。

key: Actually, it can happen for a few reasons. A defect is one option, but if a ball is damaged and not maintained, it can cause data loss.
en: Actually, it can happen for a few reasons. A defect is one option, but if a ball is damaged and not maintained, it can cause data loss.
ja: 実は、原因はいくつか考えられるんだ。不良品ってこともあるが、傷んだボールを手入れせずに放っておくと、データが失われることもある。

key: Here, let me see it?
en: Here, let me see it?
ja: ちょっと見せてもらえるか?

key: Mmm. Right, so see this crack?
en: Mmm. Right, so see this crack?
ja: うむ。ほら、このひび、見えるか?

key: It was probably dropped from a long way up or something. That doesn't matter.
en: It was probably dropped from a long way up or something. That doesn't matter.
ja: たぶん、かなり高いところから落としたんだろう。まあ、それはどうでもいい。

key: The problem is, if some debris gets through the exterior into the circuits, then it can distort the electric transmission, and then-- well, this happens.
en: The problem is, if some debris gets through the exterior into the circuits, then it can distort the electric transmission, and then-- well, this happens.
ja: 問題は、外殻を通ってゴミが回路にまで入り込むと、電気信号がゆがんでしまうことでね……その結果が、これってわけだ。

key: It might not be impossible to fix, but you're honestly better off just buying another ball.
en: It might not be impossible to fix, but you're honestly better off just buying another ball.
ja: 直せないこともないだろうが、正直、新しいボールを買ったほうがいいと思うぞ。

key: DESIGNER: You're determined to fix this ball? It probably won't be usable no matter what.
en: DESIGNER: You're determined to fix this ball? It probably won't be usable no matter what.
ja: デザイナー: このボールを直すつもりなのか? どうやったって使い物にはならないと思うがな。

key: There is the chance that a Pokémon was inside at one point, but...
en: There is the chance that a Pokémon was inside at one point, but...
ja: かつて中にポケモンが入っていた可能性もあるが……

key: Well, when inside Poké Balls, lifeforce data of Pokémon is converted to a digital format. Meaning the Pokémon itself can corrupt as well.
en: Well, when inside Poké Balls, lifeforce data of Pokémon is converted to a digital format. Meaning the Pokémon itself can corrupt as well.
ja: モンスターボールの中では、ポケモンの生命エネルギーはデジタルデータに変換される。つまり、ポケモン自体が壊れてしまうこともあるということだ。

key: Whatever this originally was before, it's probably Missingno now.
en: Whatever this originally was before, it's probably Missingno now.
ja: 元は何だったにせよ、今はもうけつばんになっているだろうな。

key: Missingno can't be caught or tamed, so there's no point to that.
en: Missingno can't be caught or tamed, so there's no point to that.
ja: けつばんは捕まえることも手懐けることもできないから、そうしても意味がない。

key: Are you sure you still want to fix it?
en: Are you sure you still want to fix it?
ja: それでも、まだ直したいのか?

key: DESIGNER: I see.
en: DESIGNER: I see.
ja: デザイナー: なるほどな。

key: I have an old diagnostic kit with me, let me see if I can detect any lingering data in the ball.
en: I have an old diagnostic kit with me, let me see if I can detect any lingering data in the ball.
ja: 古い診断キットを持ってきてるから、ボールに残ってるデータがあるか調べてみよう。

key: Mm... The data corruption is already at 96%.
en: Mm... The data corruption is already at 96%.
ja: うむ……データの破損はすでに96%だな。

key: This is probably useless, but let's see what we can use...
en: This is probably useless, but let's see what we can use...
ja: たぶん無駄だろうが、何が使えるか見てみるとしよう……

key: Ah, Magnet Powder.
en: Ah, Magnet Powder.
ja: ああ、じしゃくのこなか。

key: That will be small enough to slip inside the crack. Then, there's a chance that can reboot the internal circuitry.
en: That will be small enough to slip inside the crack.  Then, there's a chance that can reboot the internal circuitry.
ja: これならひびの中に入り込むくらい小さい。うまくいけば、内部回路を再起動できる可能性がある。

key: Of course, it might also erase the circuitry.
en: Of course, it might also erase the circuitry.
ja: もちろん、回路ごと消し去ってしまう可能性もあるがな。

key: But we don't have a better option, given the conditions. It's a gamble.
en: But we don't have a better option, given the conditions. It's a gamble.
ja: だが、この状況じゃ他にましな手はない。賭けだ。

key: DESIGNER: That's the sensible choice.
en: DESIGNER: That's the sensible choice.
ja: デザイナー: それが分別のある選択だな。

key: It's always sad when broken balls have to be thrown away.
en: It's always sad when broken balls have to be thrown away.
ja: 壊れたボールを捨てなきゃいけないのは、いつだって悲しいものだ。

key: DESIGNER: You brought Magnet Powder, I see. Well, I can't say I don't admire your commitment, but it's probably pointless.
en: DESIGNER: You brought Magnet Powder, I see. Well, I can't say I don't admire your commitment, but it's probably pointless.
ja: デザイナー: じしゃくのこなを持ってきたのか。その意気込みは大したもんだが、たぶん無駄になるぞ。

key: Anyway, let's see what we can do.
en: Anyway, let's see what we can do.
ja: とにかく、できることをやってみよう。

key: The corruption is at 98% now.
en: The corruption is at 98% now.
ja: 破損は今、98%だ。

key: Are you prepared to defeat the Missingno inside? It would be problematic to let it free.
en: Are you prepared to defeat the Missingno inside? It would be problematic to let it free.
ja: 中にいるけつばんを倒す覚悟はあるか? 野放しにするのはまずいからな。

key: DESIGNER: All right, if you're sure...
en: DESIGNER: All right, if you're sure...
ja: デザイナー: よし、そのつもりなら……

key: Let's do it this way.
en: Let's do it this way.
ja: この方法でやってみよう。

key: DESIGNER: Magnet Powder is in... It's going to juggle the circuits a bit, and with any luck, there will be a second where the ball 'forgets' that it's broken.
en: DESIGNER: Magnet Powder is in... It's going to juggle the circuits a bit, and with any luck, there will be a second where the ball 'forgets' that it's broken.
ja: デザイナー: じしゃくのこなを投入……回路が多少かき乱されるはずだ、うまくいけば、ボールが自分が壊れてることを一瞬「忘れる」かもしれない。

key: Either that or the data will be deleted entirely.
en: Either that or the data will be deleted entirely.
ja: それか、データが完全に消え去るかのどちらかだ。

key: So here we go...
en: So here we go...
ja: それじゃ、行くぞ……

key: The corruption has reached 99%. We're probably too late anyway.
en: The corruption has reached 99%. We're probably too late anyway.
ja: 破損は99%に達した。どのみち、もう手遅れかもしれんな。

key: There it is!
en: There it is!
ja: 来たぞ!

key: RALTS: Ra...?
en: RALTS: Ra...?
ja: ラルトス: ラル……?

key: DESIGNER: Huh? The Pokémon survived?
en: DESIGNER: Huh? The Pokémon survived?
ja: デザイナー: え? ポケモンが生き残った?

key: But there's less than a 1% chance that it could have...
en: But there's less than a 1% chance that it could have...
ja: でも、その確率は1%にも満たなかったはずだが……

key: DESIGNER: Hm... This Ralts must be very brave to hang on through the corruption.
en: DESIGNER: Hm... This Ralts must be very brave to hang on through the corruption.
ja: デザイナー: ふむ……この破損に耐え抜いたとは、このラルトス、よほど勇敢だったんだろう。

key: Ralts are known to be very loyal Pokémon, so perhaps it had faith that its Trainer would release it before it expired.
en: Ralts are known to be very loyal Pokémon, so perhaps it had faith that its Trainer would release it before it expired.
ja: ラルトスは忠実なポケモンとして知られているからな、消え去る前にトレーナーが解放してくれると信じていたのかもしれない。

key: But if the corruption had reached 100%, Ralts definitely would have been deleted.
en: But if the corruption had reached 100%, Ralts definitely would have been deleted.
ja: だが、破損が100%に達していたら、このラルトスは間違いなく消えていただろう。

key: It seems we were just in time.
en: It seems we were just in time.
ja: どうやら、ぎりぎり間に合ったようだな。

key: And I doubted your judgment.
en: And I doubted your judgment.
ja: お前の判断を疑ったりして。

key: My error entirely. Apologies.
en: My error entirely. Apologies.
ja: 私の完全な過ちだ。すまなかったな。

key: Well, there's no telling what became of its previous Trainer, and even this ball is unusable.
en: Well, there's no telling what became of its previous Trainer, and even this ball is unusable.
ja: まあ、前のトレーナーがどうなったかは分からないし、このボール自体ももう使い物にならない。

key: I think it's safe to say Ralts belongs to you now.
en: I think it's safe to say Ralts belongs to you now.
ja: このラルトスは、もうお前のものだと言ってよさそうだな。

key: RALTS: Raaa...
en: RALTS: Raaa...
ja: ラルトス: ラルゥ……

key: DESIGNER: Then it's best we don't do this. There would be no point anyway-- except perhaps putting the thing out of its glitchy misery.
en: DESIGNER: Then it's best we don't do this. There would be no point anyway-- except perhaps putting the thing out of its glitchy misery.
ja: デザイナー: それなら、これはやらないほうがいい。どのみち意味はないだろう――バグまみれの苦しみから解放してやる、というくらいのものだ。

key: DESIGNER: We'll need some Magnet Powder.
en: DESIGNER: We'll need some Magnet Powder.
ja: デザイナー: じしゃくのこなが必要だな。

key: It might also erase the circuitry, but we don't have a better option, given the conditions. It's a gamble.
en: It might also erase the circuitry, but we don't have a better option, given the conditions. It's a gamble.
ja: 回路ごと消してしまう可能性もあるが、この状況じゃ他にましな手はない。賭けだ。

key: DESIGNER: It's always sad when broken balls have to be thrown away.
en: DESIGNER: It's always sad when broken balls have to be thrown away.
ja: デザイナー: 壊れたボールを捨てなきゃいけないのは、いつだって悲しいものだ。

key: You had faith in Ralts to the end, didn't you? It deserves a Trainer like you.
en: You had faith in Ralts to the end, didn't you? It deserves a Trainer like you.
ja: お前は最後までラルトスを信じてたんだな。こいつには、お前みたいなトレーナーがふさわしいよ。

key: Welcome to Critical Capture! We've got some extra stock in. Wanna see?
en: Welcome to Critical Capture! We've got some extra stock in. Wanna see?
ja: 「クリティカルキャプチャー」へようこそ! 追加の在庫が入ったんだ。見てみるか?

key: Happy hunting, Trainer.
en: Happy hunting, Trainer.
ja: 良い狩りを、トレーナーよ。

key: A stack of job applications for Critical Capture sits on the counter.
en: A stack of job applications for Critical Capture sits on the counter.
ja: カウンターに、「クリティカルキャプチャー」の求人応募用紙の束が置いてある。

key: Take one?
en: Take one?
ja: 一枚もらう?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
